title: The comparison of the evolution of the Digital Economy among the members of the European Union using data-driven methodologies

detail.title: The comparison of the evolution of the Digital Economy among the members of the European Union using data-driven methodologies
detail.abstract: This paper compares the evolution of the digital economy across the 27 European Union member states between 1995 and 2023, using the Information and Communication Activities (ICA) index and multiple clustering methodologies. It applies four baseline techniques — (K-Means, Ward hierarchical clustering, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) based K-Means, and Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) hierarchical alongside five more methodologies, including constrained DTW, DTW K-Means with Dynamic Time Warping Barycenter Averaging (DBA), Soft-DTW, k-Shape, and feature-based K-Means. The results show four groups of countries: (i) rapid catch-up (eight countries), (ii) gradual-progress group (seven), (iii) stable advanced-economies (nine), and (iv) stagnant / declining group (three). The results support that shape-based, data-driven classification provides a more robust classification of digital development paths than any single-method analysis. EU institutions can create more effective targeted policies, taking both current positions and long-term evolution patterns. Overall, the results show that same strategies cannot work for all countries.

AI.tldr: 本文使用ICA指数和多种聚类方法，将1995-2023年间27个欧盟国家的数字经济发展划分为四类：快速追赶型（8国）、渐进型（7国）、稳定先进型（9国）和停滞/衰退型（3国），并发现基于形状的数据驱动分类比单一方法更稳健。
AI.research_question: 1995-2023年间，欧盟27个成员国的数字经济发展呈现怎样的聚类模式？不同聚类方法对分类结果有何影响？
AI.motivation: 单一方法对数字经济发展路径的分类可能存在偏差，需要更稳健、数据驱动的多方法比较来揭示欧盟各国数字经济的异质性演化轨迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息通信活动（ICA）指数；聚类分析理论（K-Means、层次聚类、DTW等）；数字经济发展阶段理论。
AI.method: 使用ICA指数，应用9种聚类方法：K-Means、Ward层次聚类、基于PCA的K-Means、DTW层次聚类、约束DTW、DTW DBA K-Means、Soft-DTW、k-Shape和基于特征的K-Means。
AI.findings: （1）欧盟27国分为四类：快速追赶型（8国）、渐进型（7国）、稳定先进型（9国）、停滞/衰退型（3国）；（2）基于形状的数据驱动分类比单一方法更稳健；（3）同一策略不能适用于所有国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了基于形状（shape-based）的时序聚类方法在数字经济发展路径分类中比传统单一方法更稳健，丰富了数字经济演化比较的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟机构制定差异化、有针对性的数字化政策提供依据，强调需考虑各国当前水平和长期演化模式，而非采取"一刀切"策略。

title: Who Is Afraid of the Perfect Storm? A Systematic Review of Digital Transformation, Social Fractures, and New Geography of Business Environments
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Who Is Afraid of the Perfect Storm? A Systematic Review of Digital Transformation, Social Fractures, and New Geography of Business Environments
detail.abstract: Global business environments are increasingly defined not by isolated disruptions but by the systemic collision of three converging forces: digital transformation, deepening social fractures, and reconfiguring economic geography. This systematic review synthesizes 68 peer-reviewed studies (2015–2025) across 14 countries, following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, to examine how these forces interact and amplify one another to generate what we term a "perfect storm" of nonlinear, endogenous volatility. Grounded in Dynamic Capabilities Theory — with Institutional Theory and complex adaptive systems theory as complementary frameworks — the review makes four theoretically distinctive contributions: (1) it proposes the Digital-Socio-Geographic (DSG) Volatility Matrix, formalizing business environment volatility as V = Ψ(D, S, G) — an emergent, superadditive property of recursive interactions between Digital Flux, Social Fragility, and Geographic Fluidity; (2) it specifies four testable causal hypotheses connecting the three DSG dimensions; (3) it derives the meta-capability of anticipatory agility, extending Dynamic Capabilities Theory to endogenous systemic volatility; and (4) it introduces the institutional lag paradox as a mechanism through which transnational governance deficits become self-reproducing. A structured four-priority research agenda is proposed for empirical validation across diverse international business contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理2015-2025年间68篇同行评审研究，提出数字转型、社会撕裂与经济地理重塑三重力量正系统性地碰撞，形成一种"完美风暴"式的非线性、内生性波动。作者基于动态能力理论，辅以制度理论与复杂适应系统理论，构建了数字-社会-地理（DSG）波动矩阵，并提出"预期敏捷性"这一元能力概念，将动态能力理论拓展至应对内生系统性波动。
AI.research_question: 数字化转型、社会裂痕加深与经济地理重构这三股力量如何相互作用并相互放大，从而产生一种非线性、内生的商业环境波动（"完美风暴"）？
AI.motivation: 全球商业环境正日益被多重力量的系统性碰撞所定义，而非孤立的单一冲击，但现有研究缺乏对这一系统性相互作用的理论框架和实证整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核心理论：动态能力理论（Dynamic Capabilities Theory）；补充框架：制度理论（Institutional Theory）与复杂适应系统理论（complex adaptive systems theory）。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，遵循PRISMA 2020指南，整合2015–2025年间来自14个国家的68篇同行评审研究。
AI.findings: （1）提出DSG波动矩阵，将商业环境波动形式化为V = Ψ(D, S, G)——数字流变、社会脆弱性与地理流动性之间递归互动的涌现性、超加性属性；（2）提出四项可检验的因果假设；（3）推导出"预期敏捷性"这一元能力，将动态能力理论拓展至内生系统性波动；（4）引入"制度滞后悖论"，揭示跨国治理缺陷如何自我复制。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出DSG波动矩阵，形式化了多重力量互动的涌现属性；（2）将动态能力理论从应对单一冲击拓展至应对内生系统性波动；（3）引入制度滞后悖论，为理解跨国治理缺陷的自我复制机制提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四项优先研究议程，为跨国企业在复杂多变的全球商业环境中的战略决策和实证验证提供了结构化指导。

title: Building and Managing Political Consensus Through the Internet: A Projectual Model
affiliations: and Università di Modena e Reggio Emilia

detail.title: Building and Managing Political Consensus Through the Internet: A Projectual Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper focuses on the digital applications in political communication and for building consensus, assuming that we need to overcome the idea of the Internet as a simple means of mass communication and instead analyse it as a social medium for acquiring, activating, and involving people in a specific political idea or movement. The social developments under way in Internet networks are leading to an integration between reality and virtual reality, thus making the Internet an increasingly faithful representation of the real world and of different subjects’ social networks. This makes Internet a great opportunity for building consensus. On the base of these considerations, we are going to elaborate a model for political communication on the Internet, which is integrated in the political marketing flow and articulated in three phases: acquisition, activation and defense. This model is based on the significant case study of Barack Obama and on the innovative approach in using website by Ségolène Royal.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了互联网作为社交媒介在政治沟通和建立共识中的应用，基于奥巴马和罗亚尔的案例，提出了一个整合于政治营销流程中的三阶段（获取、激活、防御）模型。
AI.research_question: 互联网如何作为一种社交媒介（而非简单的大众传播工具）用于政治沟通和建立共识？
AI.motivation: 需要超越将互联网视为简单大众传播手段的观念，将其分析为获取、激活和吸引人们参与特定政治理念或运动的社交媒介。
AI.theoretical_framework: 互联网作为社会媒介的理论；现实与虚拟现实的融合；政治营销流模型。
AI.method: 基于奥巴马和罗亚尔案例的模型构建，定性案例分析。
AI.findings: 提出了一个整合于政治营销流程的三阶段模型：获取（acquisition）、激活（activation）和防御（defense）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将互联网重新定义为社会媒介而非大众传播工具，并提出了系统化的政治沟通三阶段模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政治竞选和运动提供了在互联网上进行分阶段沟通的策略框架，尤其是通过社交网络获取和动员支持者。

title: The Wellbeing Gap: Why Organizational Programs Aren't Enough and How Leaders Can Build a Habit Maker Culture
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Wellbeing Gap: Why Organizational Programs Aren't Enough and How Leaders Can Build a Habit Maker Culture
detail.abstract: Wellbeing is not an isolated issue that only happens in our time off work but has entered our work life. Whilst organizational wellbeing programs exist at some companies, these initiatives depend heavily on the offering of the specific workplace and are not available to all employees. The concept of empowering the individual to be in control of their own work-wellbeing is an angle worthwhile exploring given the high demand of wellbeing solutions by both employees and organizations. We are looking into the concept of empowerment from two angles. Firstly, to empower the individual to create wellbeing habits at work that are within their control. Secondly, to explore the role of leadership from the perspective of empowering others to let people come up with their own solutions. Using insights from a study with 522 participants who answered open-ended questions about their habits, the Power-Move-Shift framework was derived. Power stands for getting the habit engine started, Move relates to keeping going and Shift looks into how we can change our thinking. Focusing on the ‘How’ and ‘Why’ of Habit Making and letting employees choose their ‘What’ can be fruitful in creating a thriving organizational culture rooted in wellbeing.

AI.tldr: 本文基于522名参与者的开放式问卷调查，提出了权力-行动-转变（Power-Move-Shift）框架，探讨如何通过赋予个体掌控工作幸福感的能力以及领导者的赋能角色，来促进工作场所的幸福习惯养成，从而营造以幸福为导向的组织文化。
AI.research_question: 如何通过个体赋能和领导赋能，让员工自主掌控工作幸福感，并形成可持续的幸福习惯？
AI.motivation: 现有的组织幸福计划依赖于特定工作场所的资源，并非所有员工都能受益。因此，探索让个体自主掌控自身工作幸福感的路径具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权力-行动-转变（Power-Move-Shift）框架：Power指启动习惯引擎，Move指保持习惯的持续性，Shift指改变思维方式。
AI.method: 对522名参与者进行开放式问卷调查，收集关于其工作幸福感习惯的数据，并通过质性分析推导出Power-Move-Shift框架。
AI.findings: 让员工专注于习惯的"如何"（How）和"为什么"（Why），而非强制规定"做什么"（What），有助于营造以幸福感为导向的组织文化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Power-Move-Shift框架，将习惯养成与工作幸福感相结合，拓展了组织行为学中关于赋能与幸福感的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和领导者提供了具体的赋能策略：让个体自主选择幸福习惯的内容，领导者则通过赋能他人而非直接干预来支持员工的幸福实践。

title: Who Am I Becoming?Affective Future Self Continuity and Entrepreneurial Role Identification
affiliations: Peres Academic Center and Peres Academic Center

detail.title: Who Am I Becoming?Affective Future Self Continuity and Entrepreneurial Role Identification
detail.abstract: This study examines how affective future self-continuity is associated with entrepreneurial intentions through entrepreneurial role identification. Drawing on role identity theory and identity based motivation perspectives, we propose that emotional connection to one’s future self is associated with greater perceived compatibility between entrepreneurship and the self concept, which in turn is associated with stronger entrepreneurial intentions. Using survey data from 479 adult participants, the findings show that affective future self-continuity is positively associated with entrepreneurial role identification, which strongly is associated with entrepreneurial intentions. The direct association between affective future self continuity and entrepreneurial intentions becomes non significant once entrepreneurial role identification is included in the model, while the indirect association remains significant. The findings suggest that future oriented self perceptions may become associated with entrepreneurial career orientation primarily when entrepreneurship is perceived as psychologically relevant and self congruent. The study contributes to identity based perspectives in entrepreneurship by highlighting the role of future oriented self perceptions in shaping entrepreneurial role relevance in pre entrepreneurial contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了情感性未来自我连续性如何通过创业角色认同与创业意图相关联。基于角色认同理论和身份驱动动机视角，研究发现情感性未来自我连续性与创业角色认同正相关，进而与更强的创业意图相关。一旦纳入创业角色认同，情感性未来自我连续性与创业意图的直接关联不再显著，而间接关联仍然显著。这表明未来导向的自我感知主要当创业被视为心理相关且与自我一致时，才可能与创业职业取向相关联。
AI.research_question: 情感性未来自我连续性如何通过创业角色认同影响个体的创业意图？
AI.motivation: 已有研究较少关注未来自我连续性在创业意图形成中的作用，尤其缺乏从身份认同视角探讨情感性未来自我连接如何转化为创业职业取向的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 角色认同理论；身份驱动动机理论。核心概念：情感性未来自我连续性、创业角色认同、创业意图。
AI.method: 问卷调查法，样本为479名成年参与者。采用路径分析/中介效应检验（创业角色认同作为中介变量）。
AI.findings: （1）情感性未来自我连续性与创业角色认同正相关；（2）创业角色认同与创业意图正相关；（3）创业角色认同完全中介了情感性未来自我连续性与创业意图之间的关系（直接效应不显著，间接效应显著）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将未来导向的自我感知视角引入创业身份研究中，揭示了情感性未来自我连续性通过创业角色认同影响创业意图的机制，丰富了身份驱动动机理论在创业前情境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业教育和干预提供启示：增强个体对未来自我的情感连接（如通过未来自我想象练习）可能有助于提升创业角色认同，进而促进创业意图的形成。

title: Consumer Willingness to Pay for Certified Safe Cassava in a Mining Affected Region of Nigeria: A Structural Equation Modelling and Discrete Choice Experiment Approach
affiliations: Adekunle Ajasin University, Edo State University Uzairue and Edo State University Uzairue

detail.title: Consumer Willingness to Pay for Certified Safe Cassava in a Mining Affected Region of Nigeria: A Structural Equation Modelling and Discrete Choice Experiment Approach
detail.abstract: Consumer responses to invisible food safety hazards in low-income agricultural settings remain poorly understood. This study investigated whether disclosure of mining-related heavy metal contamination influences purchase intentions and willingness to pay (WTP) for cassava, a staple crop in Nigeria. A cross-sectional survey of 384 cassava consumers from mining exposed (n=192) and non-exposed (n=192) communities used structural equation modelling to test a mediated pathway from origin disclosure to purchase intention through perceived threat, perceived benefit, and self-efficacy. A discrete choice experiment (DCE) with 12 choice sets quantified marginal WTP for safety attributes. Origin disclosure significantly increased perceived threat (β=0.45, p<0.001). Perceived threat enhanced both perceived benefit (β=0.62, p<0.001) and self-efficacy (β=0.38, p<0.001). Purchase intention was predicted by perceived benefit (β=0.41), self-efficacy (β=0.33), and moral norm (β=0.28, all p<0.001). The direct path from disclosure to intention was non-significant (β=0.12, p=0.087), with 58.6% of the total effect mediated. Exposed consumers showed significantly stronger pathway coefficients. Consumers demanded a discount of ₦437/kg for mining area cassava and paid premiums of ₦228 for safe origin and ₦288 for certification. Exposed consumers valued safe origin 75% more than non-exposed consumers (₦312 vs. ₦178). Findings demonstrate that credible safety certification can generate consumer premiums sufficient to create market incentives for safer agricultural practices in mining affected regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了尼日利亚木薯消费者对矿区重金属污染的认知与行为反应。研究发现，产地披露通过感知威胁、感知收益和自我效能的中介路径影响购买意愿，消费者对矿区木薯要求每公斤₦437的折扣，但愿意为安全产地和认证分别支付₦228和₦288的溢价，表明安全认证可以创造市场激励。
AI.research_question: 在低收入农业环境中，消费者对不可见的食品安全危害（矿区重金属污染）如何反应？产地披露如何影响消费者的购买意愿和支付意愿？
AI.motivation: 低收入农业环境中消费者对隐性食品安全风险（如重金属污染）的反应尚不明确。矿区附近的农作物可能受到污染，但消费者是否关心这种不可见的风险以及是否愿意为安全食品支付溢价，对于制定有效的食品安全政策和市场干预措施至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于保护动机理论（Protection Motivation Theory）和健康信念模型，构建了从产地披露到购买意愿的中介路径模型，涉及感知威胁（perceived threat）、感知收益（perceived benefit）、自我效能（self-efficacy）和道德规范（moral norm）等构念。
AI.method: 横截面调查（384名木薯消费者，来自矿区暴露社区和非暴露社区各192人）结合离散选择实验（12个选择集），采用结构方程模型（SEM）检验中介路径，并通过离散选择实验量化边际支付意愿。
AI.findings: (1) 产地披露显著增加感知威胁（β=0.45, p<0.001）；(2) 感知威胁增强感知收益（β=0.62）和自我效能（β=0.38）；(3) 购买意愿由感知收益（β=0.41）、自我效能（β=0.33）和道德规范（β=0.28）预测；(4) 中介效应占总效应的58.6%；(5) 消费者要求矿区木薯折扣₦437/kg，愿意为安全产地支付₦228溢价、为认证支付₦288溢价；(6) 暴露社区消费者对安全产地的估值比非暴露社区高75%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将保护动机理论扩展到低收入农业环境中的隐性食品安全风险情境，揭示了"产地披露→感知威胁→感知收益/自我效能→购买意愿"的中介机制，并发现矿区暴露经验会强化这一认知路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明安全认证可以产生足够的价格溢价（₦288/kg）以激励矿区农业区采取更安全的农业生产实践，为政策制定者提供基于市场机制解决矿区食品安全问题的实证依据。

title: A Bitter Lesson for Retail Demand Forecasting: Evidence from Fine-Tuning Foundation Models
affiliations: Alibaba Group, Alibaba Group, Cornell University - School of Operations Research and Information Engineering, Alibaba Group and Alibaba Group

detail.title: A Bitter Lesson for Retail Demand Forecasting: Evidence from Fine-Tuning Foundation Models
detail.abstract:
Recent advances have driven growing interest in using pretrained foundation models for time-series forecasting, marking a shift from task-specific forecasting models toward general-purpose forecasting systems. Although a growing body of literature highlights their promise across benchmark settings, the practical value of time-series foundation models (TSFMs), including Amazon's widely adopted Chronos-2, remains debated. In particular, there is limited independent evidence on how well TSFMs perform in real-world industrial settings beyond controlled benchmark evaluations.

This paper provides the first systematic and independent empirical evaluation of Chronos-2, together with two other TSFMs, using large-scale retail data from Alibaba. Our results reveal a striking finding: despite the strong performance of Alibaba’s existing deep learning-based production forecasting system, Chronos-2 substantially outperforms this baseline, improving forecasting performance by 3.5% for domestic products and 5.4% for international products. Moreover, these improvements are highly consistent across temporal dimensions and product segments, as well as in both zero-shot and fine-tuned settings.

Our results point to a potentially disruptive paradigm shift in demand forecasting, echoing Sutton's "bitter lesson'': in the long run, the largest improvements may come less from increasingly sophisticated handcrafted forecasting systems and more from scalable pretrained foundation models. Beyond forecasting accuracy, our findings also suggest that TSFMs can serve as simulators for operations, generating synthetic demand trajectories to support downstream tasks such as inventory optimization and pricing. This opens an exciting new research frontier on how to utilize TSFM-generated synthetic data to improve downstream decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地独立评估了以Chronos-2为代表的时序基础模型（TSFMs）在阿里零售大数据上的表现，发现其显著优于已有的深度学习生产预测系统，并指出这类模型可能带来需求预测领域的范式转变，同时可作为运营模拟器支持下游决策。
AI.research_question: 时序基础模型（TSFMs）在真实工业场景中的实际预测性能如何？是否优于现有的生产级深度学习预测系统？
AI.motivation: 尽管TSFMs在基准测试中表现出潜力，但缺乏独立、系统的真实工业场景实证证据，其实际价值存在争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴Sutton的"bitter lesson"观点，认为长期来看，可扩展的预训练基础模型将超越手工打造的专用预测系统；同时提出TSFMs可作为运营模拟器用于下游决策优化。
AI.method: 使用阿里巴巴大规模零售数据，对Chronos-2及其他两个TSFMs进行零样本和微调设置下的系统性评估，与阿里现有的深度学习生产预测系统进行对比。
AI.findings: Chronos-2在国内外产品上分别提升预测性能3.5%和5.4%；提升效果在时间维度、产品细分、零样本及微调设置下高度一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"bitter lesson"在需求预测领域提供了实证支持，验证了从任务专用模型到通用基础模型的范式转变；提出TSFMs作为运营模拟器的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在实际工业场景中部署TSFMs提供了独立评估证据；展示了TSFMs生成合成需求轨迹用于库存优化、定价等下游任务的潜力。

title: Constraint-aware meta-heuristic optimization with reinforcement learning-based parameter adaptation for multi-energy system configuration
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Huazhong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Constraint-aware meta-heuristic optimization with reinforcement learning-based parameter adaptation for multi-energy system configuration
detail.abstract: Optimization of multi-energy system (MES) configuration under realistic operational constraints remains highly challenging due to strong nonlinearity, non-convexity, and highly fragmented feasible regions induced by multi-carrier coupling, reliability requirements, and diverse complex operational constraints. Although simulation-based meta-heuristic approaches are widely adopted to capture energy management system (EMS)-driven operational behavior, their search processes remain largely fitness-driven and structure-blind, treating EMS simulations as black-box evaluators and neglecting the system-level information revealed by operation trajectories and feasibility assessments. As a result, existing methods often suffer from slow convergence, inefficient feasibility exploration, and frequent trapping in infeasible regions when addressing complex configuration problems. To overcome these limitations, this study proposes a meta-heuristic optimization framework enhanced by a structured feasibility repair operator for EMS-driven MES configuration. The operator exploits slack in feasible regions and violation information in infeasible regions to guide the search process, complementing the intrinsic search mechanisms of the underlying meta-heuristics. Furthermore, reinforcement learning adaptively tunes the operator activation and correction magnitude based on search feedback, facilitating a balance between exploration and feasibility. The case studies demonstrate the successful application of the proposed repair operator within genetic algorithm, particle swarm optimization, simulated annealing, and tabu search. Extensive experiments based on a highly complex EMS-driven optimization model further show that the framework improves convergence performance and enhances configuration quality across all four algorithms. The repair-enhanced variants consistently identify superior configuration solutions with comparable, and in some cases reduced, computational cost relative to the baseline algorithms. Although the reinforcement learning-based parameter adaptation introduces a moderate increase in search time, it eliminates the need for extensive pre-tuning of hyperparameter ranges. Furthermore, the repair-augmented frameworks exhibit improved robustness compared with their baseline counterparts, demonstrating higher tolerance to suboptimal hyperparameter settings, reduced sensitivity to EMS rule design, and stronger performance under stochastic operating conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于结构化可行性修复算子的元启发式优化框架，通过利用可行域松弛和不可行域违规信息，并结合强化学习自适应调参，显著提升了多能源系统配置优化的收敛性能、解质量和鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 如何克服多能源系统配置优化中因强非线性、非凸性和高度碎片化可行域导致的收敛慢、可行性探索效率低、易陷入不可行区域等问题？
AI.motivation: 现有基于仿真的元启发式方法将能源管理系统模拟视为黑箱评估器，忽略了运行轨迹和可行性评估中蕴含的系统级结构信息，导致在面对复杂配置问题时性能不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化可行性修复算子（利用可行域松弛和不可行域违规信息指导搜索）；强化学习自适应参数调节（基于搜索反馈动态调整算子激活与修正幅度）。
AI.method: 将结构化可行性修复算子嵌入遗传算法、粒子群优化、模拟退火和禁忌搜索四种元启发式算法；采用强化学习自适应调节算子激活和修正幅度；基于高复杂度EMS驱动优化模型进行广泛实验验证。
AI.findings: 修复增强变体在所有四种算法上均显著提升收敛性能和解质量，且计算成本相当或更低；强化学习参数自适应虽适度增加搜索时间，但消除了超参数预调需求；修复增强框架在次优超参数设置、EMS规则设计和随机运行条件下表现出更高鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出结构化可行性修复算子，将不可行域违规信息与可行域松弛信息系统性地融入元启发式搜索过程，突破了传统黑箱评估的局限；引入强化学习实现搜索过程中修复策略的自适应调节。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多能源系统配置优化提供了一种高效、鲁棒且易于集成的通用优化框架，能够嵌入多种主流元启发式算法，显著提升实际工程中的配置质量和优化效率。

title: When Speed Meets Structure: CEO Competitive Aggressiveness, Network Externalities, and Cross-Border Acquisitions in Platform Firms
affiliations: University of Macau, University of Macau, University of Macau, University of Macau and University of Macau

detail.title: When Speed Meets Structure: CEO Competitive Aggressiveness, Network Externalities, and Cross-Border Acquisitions in Platform Firms
detail.abstract: Using a sample of 327 U.S.-listed digital platform firms, this study examines how CEO competitive aggressiveness is associated with firms’ cross-border acquisition (CBA) activity. The empirical analyses reveal an inverted U-shaped relationship between CEO competitive aggressiveness and CBA activity in the full sample, suggesting that moderate levels of CEO competitive aggressiveness are associated with higher levels of CBA activity, whereas excessive levels of CEO competitive aggressiveness may prove counterproductive. However, when platform firms are disaggregated by the type of network externalities they face, this nonlinear relationship is observed only among firms with cross-country network externalities. By comparison, among firms operating primarily with within-country network externalities, CEO competitive aggressiveness is positively and linearly associated with CBA activity. These findings underscore the importance of considering heterogeneity in network externalities when assessing how CEO behavioral traits shape international expansion strategies. In addition, the study examines the moderating roles of CEO tenure and CEO duality in shaping these relationships.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了327家美国上市数字平台企业的CEO竞争侵略性与跨境并购活动的关系，发现二者呈倒U型关系，且这种关系受网络外部性类型的调节。
AI.research_question: CEO竞争侵略性与数字平台企业跨境并购（CBA）活动之间存在怎样的关系？这种关系如何受网络外部性类型（跨国vs国内）以及CEO任期和CEO二元性的调节？
AI.motivation: 数字平台企业日益通过跨境并购实现国际化扩张，但CEO个性特征（尤其是竞争侵略性）如何影响这一战略决策尚不明确。同时，平台企业的网络外部性特性可能调节CEO特质与国际化战略之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高层梯队理论（Upper Echelons Theory）、竞争侵略性（Competitive Aggressiveness）、网络外部性理论（Network Externalities）
AI.method: 基于327家美国上市数字平台企业的样本，采用实证分析方法，检验CEO竞争侵略性与CBA活动之间的非线性关系，并进行异质性分析（按网络外部性类型分组）。
AI.findings: （1）全样本中，CEO竞争侵略性与CBA活动呈倒U型关系，即适度水平的竞争侵略性最有利于CBA，过高则适得其反；（2）该倒U型关系仅存在于具有跨国网络外部性的平台企业中；（3）在主要面向国内网络外部性的企业中，CEO竞争侵略性与CBA活动呈正向线性关系；（4）CEO任期和CEO二元性对上述关系具有调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将高层梯队理论与平台企业的网络外部性特征相结合，揭示了CEO特质与国际化战略关系的边界条件，证明了网络外部性类型是重要的调节变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字平台企业在跨境并购中如何选拔和配置CEO提供参考：对于面向跨国网络外部性的平台，应避免过度激进或过于保守的CEO；对于面向国内网络外部性的平台，更激进的CEO反而有利。

title: The Discursive Divide: Gender, Institutional Representation, and Digital-TradePolicy in Cambodia
affiliations: Teesside University and Teesside University

detail.title: The Discursive Divide: Gender, Institutional Representation, and Digital-TradePolicy in Cambodia
detail.abstract: yet they remain markedly under-represented in the country’s accelerating digital-trade economy. Existing scholarshipon gender and digital trade in Southeast Asia is dominated by macro-level indicators and case-based evidence, withlimited mixed-methods evidence on how women-led businesses and the institutions that support them engage withnational digital trade policy. We ask whether, and how, gendered patterns in stakeholder discourse on digital-tradepolicy reflect underlying structural exclusions, and what they imply for policy design. We conducted four full-daystakeholder workshops in Phnom Penh, Siem Reap, Kampot, and Battambang in 2024, generating survey, focus-group,and key-informant-interview data from 490 participants (752 codeable utterances, 337 contributed by women). Applyingdual deductive–inductive thematic coding (six themes; Cohen’s κ = 0.78), followed by χ2 tests of independence,Wilson confidence intervals, and logistic-regression contrasts, we identify three patterns. First, the headline aggregategender gap is not statistically significant once organisation type is controlled for (χ2(5) = 8.57, p = 0.128). The apparentgender effects are absorbed by a strong gender–organisation association (χ2(3) = 39.4, p < 0.001, Cram´er’sV = 0.23). Second, of six pre-specified theme-level contrasts, only mentorship and networking reach nominal significance(ORF = 2.10, 95% CI [1.06, 4.14]), and this effect does not survive Benjamini–Hochberg correction; wetreat it as exploratory. Third, the apparent barrier–solution alignment (ρ = 1.00) is an artefact of the shared codingframe rather than evidence of stakeholder convergence. Gender inequality in digital trade is therefore mediated by institutionalparticipation rather than captured by unadjusted discourse counts. We introduce the concept of a discursivedivide and propose a dual-track policy framework that integrates structural reform with capacity building.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2024年在柬埔寨四省举办的490名参与者工作坊数据，运用混合方法（调查、焦点小组、关键知情人访谈）和双重演绎-归纳主题编码，发现数字贸易政策话语中的性别差异并非简单的数量差距，而是由组织参与类型所中介的结构性排斥。文章提出"话语鸿沟"概念和双轨政策框架。
AI.research_question: 数字贸易政策话语中的性别化模式是否以及如何反映潜在的结构性排斥？这对政策设计意味着什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管东南亚数字经济加速发展，但女性领导的企业在数字贸易经济中仍显著代表不足。现有研究以宏观指标和案例证据为主，缺乏关于女性领导企业及支持机构如何参与国家数字贸易政策的混合方法证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 话语鸿沟（discursive divide）；结构性排斥理论；性别与制度参与的中介效应
AI.method: 2024年在柬埔寨金边、暹粒、贡布、马德望四省举办共4天利益相关者工作坊，收集490名参与者的调查、焦点小组和关键知情人访谈数据（752条可编码话语，337条由女性贡献）。采用双重演绎-归纳主题编码（6个主题，Cohen's κ=0.78），随后进行卡方独立性检验、Wilson置信区间和逻辑回归对比分析。
AI.findings: （1）一旦控制组织类型，总体的性别差距不显著（χ²(5)=8.57, p=0.128），性别效应被性别-组织强关联吸收（χ²(3)=39.4, p<0.001, Cramér's V=0.23）；（2）六个预设主题对比中，仅导师指导和网络建设达到名义显著性（OR=2.10, 95%CI [1.06,4.14]），但未通过Benjamini-Hochberg校正；（3）表面上的障碍-解决方案对齐（ρ=1.00）是共享编码框架的人为产物，非利益相关者共识的证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"话语鸿沟"概念，揭示性别不平等在数字贸易中并非被未调整的话语计数所捕获，而是由制度参与所中介，为理解数字贸易政策中的结构性性别排斥提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"双轨政策框架"，将结构性改革与能力建设相结合，为数字贸易政策设计提供了具体的性别包容性路径。

title: What Do Bitcoin Premiums Measure? Evidence from Global P2P Markets
affiliations: Ecole Polytechnique Federale de Lausanne - MTEI

detail.title: What Do Bitcoin Premiums Measure? Evidence from Global P2P Markets
detail.abstract: This paper studies what Bitcoin (BTC) premiums in peer-to-peer (P2P) markets measure. Using transaction-level data from LocalBitcoins, we construct BTC premiums for 80 currencies relative to the U.S. dollar and relate them to blockchain transaction conditions, centralized crypto market (CEX) conditions, cross-border payment frictions, and foreign exchange (FX) markets.We show that these premiums reflect both trading frictions within crypto markets and local frictions in access to cross-border payments. They vary systematically with blockchain conditions and broader crypto market conditions, including BTC returns and volatility, and they are larger in countries facing greater frictions in conventional cross-border payment channels. This pattern is especially pronounced in economies with binding institutional constraints, i.e., tight capital controls and non-floating exchange-rate regimes, consistent with greater reliance on P2P crypto markets as an alternative cross-border payment channel.We further show that rising FX pressure is absorbed mainly through prices rather than trading volumes, and that P2P BTC premiums predict subsequent official exchange rate depreciation. Although premium levels differ across countries, their predictive content remains broadly similar.Overall, P2P BTC premiums reflect limits to arbitrage across crypto trading venues, especially where formal cross-border payment channels are more constrained, and they also embed forward-looking information about currency depreciation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用LocalBitcoins平台交易级数据，研究了80种货币相对于美元的P2P比特币溢价如何反映加密货币市场交易摩擦和跨境支付摩擦，并发现这些溢价可预测官方汇率贬值。
AI.research_question: P2P市场中的比特币溢价衡量了什么？它们如何反映市场摩擦和跨境支付约束？
AI.motivation: P2P比特币市场在发展中国家尤为重要，但其溢价的经济含义尚不清晰；需要区分其反映的是加密货币内部摩擦还是传统金融体系的外部摩擦。
AI.theoretical_framework: 套利限制理论（limits to arbitrage）；跨境支付摩擦理论；汇率决定理论。
AI.method: 利用LocalBitcoins交易级数据构建80种货币对美元的P2P BTC溢价；将其与区块链交易条件、中心化交易所条件、跨境支付摩擦和外汇市场数据进行回归分析。
AI.findings: P2P BTC溢价同时反映加密货币市场交易摩擦和跨境支付通道摩擦；在资本管制严格、汇率制度非浮动的经济体中，溢价更大；溢价主要体现为价格调整而非交易量变化；P2P BTC溢价可预测官方汇率贬值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将P2P加密货币溢价理论与套利限制、跨境支付摩擦理论相结合，揭示了加密货币市场与传统金融市场之间的互动机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了理解P2P加密货币市场在资本管制环境下作用的视角；为市场参与者提供了利用P2P溢价作为汇率贬值预测指标的参考。

title: A SYSTEM ONTOLOGY OF STRATEGY: RELATIONAL CAUSALITY AND DYNAMIC COHERENCE ​
affiliations: Tarbiat Modares University

detail.title: A SYSTEM ONTOLOGY OF STRATEGY: RELATIONAL CAUSALITY AND DYNAMIC COHERENCE ​
detail.abstract: ABSTRACT Strategic management remains theoretically fragmented because existing perspectives lack a shared system ontology of strategy. This Perspective conceptualizes strategy as a dynamic system of interdependent organizational relationships organized around coherence, interaction, and continuous renewal. It advances a system-oriented foundation for explaining how organizations sustain coordinated adaptation in changing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将战略视为由相互依赖的组织关系构成的动态系统，围绕一致性、互动和持续更新来组织，为解释组织如何在变化环境中维持协调适应提供了系统导向的基础。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的系统本体论来克服战略管理领域的理论碎片化问题？
AI.motivation: 现有战略管理视角缺乏共享的系统本体论，导致理论碎片化，迫切需要一种统一的概念基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态系统理论；战略作为相互依赖的组织关系系统；一致性、互动与持续更新三个核心维度。
AI.method: 理论构建/概念性研究（Perspective类型论文）。
AI.findings: 战略可以被概念化为一个动态系统，其核心机制包括一致性（coherence）、互动（interaction）和持续更新（continuous renewal），这三个维度共同解释了组织如何在变化环境中实现协调适应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为战略管理提供了一个统一的系统本体论基础，有助于弥合不同战略视角之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了一种系统思维框架，帮助理解组织如何通过维持一致性、促进互动和推动持续更新来应对环境变化。

title: EGD-MKANet: Edge-Guided per-Channel Gated Decoder withMemory-friendly Multi-Kernel Aggregation
affiliations: Guangxi Minzu University, Guangxi Minzu University, Guangxi Minzu University, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Department of Medical Ultrasonics and Guangxi University for Nationalities

detail.title: EGD-MKANet: Edge-Guided per-Channel Gated Decoder withMemory-friendly Multi-Kernel Aggregation
detail.abstract: Medical image segmentation is a cornerstone of Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD). However, existing U-shapedarchitectures frequently struggle to strike a balance between global context modeling and computational efficiency,particularly when delineating multi-scale targets with ambiguous boundaries. Furthermore, the inherent semantic gapwithin skip connections often restricts further improvements in segmentation precision. To address these challenges,we propose EGD-MKANet, a high-efficiency network designed to synergize edge refinement with robust semanticfusion. The proposed model incorporates three core innovations: (1) a Multi-Kernel Aggregation (MKA) module,which employs memory-efficient parallel dilated convolutions as a linear-complexity alternative to computationallyexpensive self-attention mechanisms, effectively capturing multi-scale global context; (2) an Edge-Guided Channelwise Gating Decoder (EGD), which leverages a channel-wise gating mechanism to adaptively filter skip-connectionfeatures and utilizes explicit edge supervision to suppress background noise and rectify cross-level feature misalignment; and (3) a Multi-task Deep Supervision strategy that integrates distance and edge auxiliary branches to enhancethe network’s perception of minute targets and touching instances. Extensive experiments were conducted acrossseven public datasets encompassing three modalities: colorectal polyps, nuclei, and skin lesions. Quantitative results demonstrate that EGD-MKANet achieves superior performance, recording mean Dice scores (mDice) of 0.9412on Kvasir-SEG and 0.9337 on DSB2018. Notably, our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches,including TransUNet and SegFormer, while maintaining a low parameter count and real-time inference speeds. Consequently, the proposed framework effectively resolves issues related to boundary ambiguity and scale variation, holdingsubstantial promise for clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EGD-MKANet，一种融合边缘细化与语义融合的高效医学图像分割网络，通过多核聚合模块、边缘引导门控解码器和多任务深度监督策略，在多个医学图像数据集上实现了SOTA性能，同时保持低参数量和实时推理速度。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种高效且精确的医学图像分割网络，以解决现有U形架构在全局上下文建模与计算效率之间的平衡问题，以及跳跃连接中的语义鸿沟问题？
AI.motivation: 现有U形分割网络难以兼顾全局上下文建模与计算效率，尤其在处理边界模糊的多尺度目标时表现不佳；同时跳跃连接中的语义鸿沟限制了分割精度的进一步提升。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多尺度全局上下文建模、边缘引导特征融合、通道门控机制、多任务深度监督学习
AI.method: 提出EGD-MKANet，包含三个核心组件：(1) 多核聚合模块 (MKA)：使用内存高效的并行膨胀卷积替代昂贵的自注意力机制，以线性复杂度捕获多尺度全局上下文；(2) 边缘引导通道门控解码器 (EGD)：利用通道门控机制自适应过滤跳跃连接特征，并借助显式边缘监督抑制背景噪声、矫正跨层级特征错位；(3) 多任务深度监督：集成距离和边缘辅助分支，增强网络对微小目标和接触实例的感知能力。
AI.findings: 在7个公开数据集（涵盖结直肠息肉、细胞核和皮肤病变三种模态）上的实验表明，EGD-MKANet在Kvasir-SEG上达到0.9412 mDice，在DSB2018上达到0.9337 mDice，显著优于TransUNet和SegFormer等SOTA方法，同时参数更少、推理速度达到实时水平。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出MKA模块，以线性复杂度替代自注意力机制实现多尺度全局上下文建模；(2) 提出EGD解码器，通过门控机制和边缘监督解决语义鸿沟问题；(3) 提出多任务深度监督策略，增强对微小目标的感知。
AI.practical_contributions: 所提框架有效解决了边界模糊和尺度变化问题，具有低参数量和实时推理速度，具备临床部署的实用潜力。

title: Complete Monotonicity for the Ruin-Time Density in the Cram\'er--Lundberg Model
affiliations: University of Liverpool

detail.title: Complete Monotonicity for the Ruin-Time Density in the Cram\'er--Lundberg Model
detail.abstract: We study complete monotonicity of the defective ruin-time density in the classical Cram\'er--Lundberg model. We show that complete monotonicity is equivalent to the discounted ruin transform being a Stieltjes function. This yields a complete solution for exponential claims: the density is completely monotone, hence decreasing and convex, exactly for initial capitals $0\le u\le u_c=\sqrt{c/(\alpha\lambda)}$, and it fails beyond $u_c$. For Erlang$(k)$ claims with $k\ge2$ we prove failure at zero capital, and for Erlang$(2)$ at every positive capital. We also record a practical zero-capital criterion in terms of $H(q)=q/\Phi(q)$ and an explicit hyperexponential algebraic benchmark. Detailed numerics are kept in the supplementary package.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了经典Cramér–Lundberg模型中破产时间密度的完全单调性，证明了完全单调性等价于贴现破产变换为Stieltjes函数，并给出了指数索赔情形下的完整解以及Erlang索赔的相关结论。
AI.research_question: 经典Cramér–Lundberg模型中缺陷破产时间密度的完全单调性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 破产时间密度的单调性和凸性对风险管理和保险定价有重要意义，完全单调性是一个强性质，需要明确其成立的条件和范围。
AI.theoretical_framework: 完全单调性、Stieltjes函数、Cramér–Lundberg模型、贴现破产变换。
AI.method: 理论推导与证明，结合不同索赔分布（指数、Erlang、超指数）进行案例分析。
AI.findings: 1) 完全单调性等价于贴现破产变换为Stieltjes函数；2) 指数索赔下，密度在初始资本0≤u≤u_c时完全单调，超过u_c则不成立；3) Erlang(k)(k≥2)在零资本时失败，Erlang(2)在任何正资本时均失败；4) 给出了零资本判据和超指数代数基准。
AI.theory_contributions: 将破产时间密度的完全单调性问题与Stieltjes函数理论建立联系，提供了完整的理论刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险精算中破产概率的计算和风险管理提供了可操作的条件和数值基准。

title: AI in Residential Real Estate: Efficiency Gains and Equity Gaps
affiliations: University of Tulsa - Collins College of Business,  and Auburn University - Department of Finance

detail.title: AI in Residential Real Estate: Efficiency Gains and Equity Gaps
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is moving through residential real estate faster than the academic evidence needed to evaluate it. We organize the literature around a simple tension: AI can make prediction, screening, matching, pricing, and generation more efficient, but it also changes who gets access, who captures surplus, who bears errors, and who faces risk. Using an equityefficiency framework, we classify roughly 145 papers across six residential domains and four AI mechanism categories. The evidence map reveals a sharp asymmetry: twenty-two of twentyfour cells lack peer-reviewed evidence on equity outcomes, even though industry deploys AI in eighteen cells and federal regulation is active in nine. Existing research is concentrated in automated valuation and mortgage credit; rental pricing, leasing automation, tenant screening, property management, and agentic workflows remain lightly studied. We translate these gaps into a research agenda anchored by regulatory shocks, vendor deployments, and residential REIT operating disclosures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了AI在住宅房地产领域应用的学术文献，发现AI虽在预测、筛选、匹配、定价和生成方面提升效率，但关于公平性的同行评审证据严重不足——在24个分析单元中，22个缺乏公平性结果的证据。研究集中在自动估值和抵押信贷领域，而租赁定价、租户筛选、物业管理等方向研究薄弱。
AI.research_question: AI在住宅房地产领域的应用如何影响效率与公平？现有学术证据的分布情况如何？
AI.motivation: AI在住宅房地产领域的部署速度远超学术评估能力，而该领域涉及住房这一基本民生需求，AI可能改变谁获得住房、谁获取剩余价值、谁承担错误和风险，因此急需系统梳理现有证据并识别研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公平-效率框架（Equity-Efficiency Framework），将分析维度分为六个住宅领域（如自动估值、抵押信贷、租赁定价等）和四类AI机制（预测、筛选/匹配、定价、生成）。
AI.method: 系统文献综述，对约145篇论文按照六类住宅领域和四类AI机制进行交叉分类，构建证据地图。
AI.findings: 1）24个分析单元中22个缺乏关于公平性结果的同行评审证据；2）AI已在18个单元中有行业部署，9个单元有联邦监管；3）现有研究集中在自动估值和抵押信贷领域；4）租赁定价、租户筛选、物业管理、代理工作流等领域研究不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了住宅房地产AI应用的系统分类框架（6领域×4机制），揭示了效率证据与公平证据之间的严重不对称，为后续研究提供了理论分析基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 明确了研究空白，提出以监管冲击、供应商部署和住宅REIT运营披露为锚点的研究议程，为政策制定者和行业实践者提供了需要优先关注的公平性问题清单。

title: ZelEn: A Quantum-Safe Governed Object-Security Architecture for the Zelfire / ZelC Ecosystem

detail.title: ZelEn: A Quantum-Safe Governed Object-Security Architecture for the Zelfire / ZelC Ecosystem

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and principal architect of Rocheston, Zelfire, and the ZelC programming language. ZelEn is a product of Rocheston. The author has a direct commercial interest in the adoption of ZelEn as a post-quantum encryption standard within the Zelfire and ZelC ecosystem. No external funding was received. No third-party financial relationships influenced the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a cryptographic architecture specification and does not involve human participants, patient data, surveys, interviews, or animal subjects. No ethics approval is required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author. No grants, institutional funding, or commercial sponsorship were received.

detail.abstract:
ZelEn is the quantum-safe encryption, identity, certificate, and secure object architecture of the Zelfire and ZelC ecosystem. It is not a new public-key primitive, and it is not presented as unbreakable, military grade, or as a replacement for NIST cryptography. ZelEn is a governed, misuse-resistant, enterprise object-security architecture that operationalizes NIST-standardized post-quantum cryptography — specifically ML-KEM (FIPS 203), ML-DSA (FIPS 204), AES-256-GCM (NIST SP 800-38D), and the KMAC256/cSHAKE256 family (NIST SP 800-185) — into concrete key files, certificate files, encrypted object containers, compiler-enforced policy, and an optional advanced structural encoding layer.

The central thesis of the paper is the following:

ZelEn does not replace NIST post-quantum cryptography; it operationalizes it into a governed, misuse-resistant, enterprise object-security architecture for the Zelfire ecosystem.

NIST builds the cryptographic engines. ZelEn builds the armored vehicle around them.

We present (i) the cryptographic suite ZELEN-PQ5 (Suite ID 0x0101); (ii) the four na tive object classes .zkey, .zpub, .zcert, and .zelen, with type-level role separation; (iii) a fixed binary container with the ASCII magic ZELEN at offset 0x00 and the ASCII brand mark ZELC at offset 0x7D, both bound into the authenticated transcript; (iv) a domain-separated key schedule built on KMAC256; (v) AEAD payload encryption with AES−256−GCM under a strict 96-bit nonce regime; (vi) an authenticated transcript signed under ML-DSA with optional SLH-DSA diversity; (vii) multi-recipient and chunked profiles; (viii) parser safety rules; (ix) ZelC compiler-level enforcement; (x) an optional finite-site/topos-inspired encoding extension (ZelEn-MTE) presented as non-load-bearing for confidentiality; (xi) a formal security model with a concrete advantage bound that reduces ZelEn object security to its underlying primitives modulo encoding and parser failure probabilities; and (xii) a non-conformant illustrative Python prototype. Wemake explicit what ZelEn does and does not claim, develop the threat model, present formal definitions and proof sketches against an adaptive chosen-ciphertext adversary, antic ipate criticism from cryptographers and CISOs in a hostile question-and-answer section, and document a compliance and validation roadmap that distinguishes using FIPS-standardized algorithms from having a FIPS-validated cryptographic module.

AI.tldr: ZelEn 并非一种新的公钥密码原语，而是一个将 NIST 标准化后量子密码（ML-KEM、ML-DSA、AES-256-GCM 等）封装为可治理、抗误用的企业级对象安全架构，包含密钥文件、证书文件、加密容器、编译器强制策略及可选编码层。
AI.research_question: 如何将 NIST 标准化的后量子密码学原语操作化为一个可治理、抗误用、面向企业对象安全的架构？
AI.motivation: NIST 提供了后量子密码引擎，但缺乏一个将引擎安全封装、治理、并提供抗误用保障的"装甲车"——ZelEn 填补了这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后量子密码学（ML-KEM、ML-DSA、AES-256-GCM）、KMAC256/cSHAKE256 域分离密钥调度、形式化安全模型（自适应选择密文攻击下的优势界限）。
AI.method: 论文提出了 (i) 密码套件 ZELEN-PQ5；(ii) 四种原生对象类（.zkey/.zpub/.zcert/.zelen）及类型级角色分离；(iii) 固定二进制容器格式；(iv) 基于 KMAC256 的域分离密钥调度；(v) AES-256-GCM AEAD 加密（严格 96 位 nonce）；(vi) ML-DSA 签名（可选 SLH-DSA 多样性）；(vii) 多接收者及分块配置；(viii) 解析器安全规则；(ix) ZelC 编译器级执行；(x) 可选的有限位点/拓扑编码扩展；(xi) 形式化安全模型；(xii) 非合规的 Python 原型演示。
AI.findings: ZelEn 的安全性可归约到其底层密码原语，附加编码和解析器失败概率；提供了明确的威胁模型和对抗自适应选择密文攻击者的证明概要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将 NIST 后量子密码原语操作化为企业级对象安全架构的形式化框架，包括域分离密钥调度、类型级角色分离、以及一个将对象安全归约到底层原语的形式化安全模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接使用的密钥文件、证书文件、加密容器格式；定义了编译器级强制策略以预防误用；给出了合规和验证路线图，区分了使用 FIPS 标准化算法与拥有 FIPS 验证模块的差异。

title: Democracy's Hidden Dividend: The Unpriced Value of Non-Provisioning Forest Ecosystem Services
affiliations: Hebrew University of Jerusalem and Hebrew University of Jerusalem _ Departement of Environmental Economics and Management

detail.title: Democracy's Hidden Dividend: The Unpriced Value of Non-Provisioning Forest Ecosystem Services
detail.abstract: We apply Mundlak's Correlated Random Effects (CRE) framework to recent global data to estimate the impact of democratization on Non-Provisioning Forest Ecosystem Services (NPFES). Because these services-such as carbon sequestration, biodiversity conservation, and hydrological regulation-are global public goods typically excluded from standard national accounts, their democracy-induced supply constitutes a hidden economic dividend. We find that a permanent transition to full democracy in a median tropical country generates a long-run NPFES dividend equivalent to 30.31% of its GDP, while a one-standard-deviation increase yields a 3.69% dividend. However, realizing these global benefits requires forest-rich nations to halt deforestation, forcing them to sacrifice short-and medium-term domestic economic gains. This trade-off disproportionately burdens developing nations, highlighting the need for international compensation. Our NPFES valuations provide an essential empirical component for designing such compensation mechanisms by explicitly estimating the global future return on investment in financing localized forest conservation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Mundlak的相关随机效应（CRE）框架，基于全球数据估计民主化对非供给性森林生态系统服务（NPFES）的影响。研究发现，向完全民主的永久转型能为中位数热带国家带来相当于其GDP 30.31%的长期NPFES红利，但这些全球性收益是以森林资源丰富国家牺牲短期和中期国内经济利益为代价的，凸显了国际补偿机制的必要性。
AI.research_question: 民主化如何影响非供给性森林生态系统服务（NPFES）的价值？这种影响在全球范围内带来的经济红利是多少？
AI.motivation: 非供给性森林生态系统服务（如碳封存、生物多样性保护、水文调节）是全球公共产品，通常被排除在标准国民经济核算之外，其由民主化带来的供给构成了"隐藏的经济红利"。理解这种红利的规模对于设计国际补偿机制、平衡发展中国家因森林保护而牺牲的国内经济利益至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: Mundlak的相关随机效应（CRE）框架；民主化对公共物品供给的影响理论；全球公共产品理论
AI.method: 采用Mundlak的相关随机效应（CRE）框架，基于近期全球面板数据进行计量分析，估计民主化水平变化对非供给性森林生态系统服务价值的影响。
AI.findings: （1）一个中位数热带国家向完全民主的永久转型，能产生相当于其GDP 30.31%的长期NPFES红利；（2）民主程度每增加一个标准差，能带来3.69%的GDP红利；（3）这些全球收益的实现需要森林资源丰富国家停止砍伐森林，迫使其牺牲短期和中期的国内经济增长；（4）这种权衡对发展中国家造成了不成比例的负担，凸显了国际补偿机制的必要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将民主化与森林生态系统服务价值联系起来，量化了民主化带来的"隐藏经济红利"，为全球公共产品供给的政治经济学提供了新的实证证据；验证了民主制度在提供全球公共品方面的积极作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非供给性森林生态系统服务提供了具体的估值，为设计国际补偿机制提供了实证基础；明确了森林保护与国内经济发展之间的权衡关系，为政策制定者设计合理的国际转移支付和补偿方案提供了量化依据。

title: Comparative Political Economy of Pollution Abatement
affiliations: California State University, San Bernardino - Department of Economics

detail.title: Comparative Political Economy of Pollution Abatement
detail.abstract: The steady state properties of various representative agent political economies with regards to pollution are explored. Providing tractable solutions for dynamic problems of neoclassical growth, varieties of capitalism and worker control, this paper analyzes the accumulation and allocation properties of these economies. The numerical solutions for the labor-intensive and capital-intensive technologies are provided for all economies facing the same parameter values and these economies comparative performance in pollution abatement is discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文探究了多种代表性代理人政治经济体在污染方面的稳态特性，通过提供新古典增长、资本主义多样性和工人控制等动态问题的可解解决方案，分析了这些经济体的积累与配置特性，并比较了它们在污染治理方面的绩效。
AI.research_question: 不同政治经济体（代表性代理人政治经济体）在污染治理方面的稳态特性及比较绩效如何？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对政治经济体在污染治理方面的动态特性分析不足，缺乏对不同制度安排下经济体污染治理绩效的系统性比较。

AI.theory_contributions: 将污染问题纳入代表性代理人政治经济体的动态分析框架，拓展了新古典增长理论、资本主义多样性理论和工人控制理论在环境经济学中的应用。

detail.abstract: This paper maps the potentials and constraints for public goods provision in Azerbaijan. It examines fiscal instruments, sovereign wealth management, infrastructure investment, environmental commons in the Caspian Sea basin, water management, urban public services, and governance factors that shape delivery. Using a mixed-methods literature synthesis and policy analysis, the paper identifies entry points to increase public good supply, enhance efficiency, and improve sustainability. Key findings: Azerbaijan's hydrocarbon wealth creates fiscal space for public investment but weak governance and project selection risks reduce longterm public value; environmental public goods in the Caspian Sea and water systems require coordinated regional action; transport and reconstruction investments can yield large social returns if transparency and project appraisal improve.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了阿塞拜疆公共品供给的潜力与制约因素，涵盖财政工具、主权财富管理、基础设施投资、里海环境公共品、水资源管理、城市公共服务及治理因素，发现碳氢化合物财富创造了财政空间，但治理薄弱和项目选择风险降低了长期公共价值，环境公共品需要区域协调行动，交通和重建投资若提高透明度和项目评估则可带来巨大社会回报。
AI.research_question: 阿塞拜疆在公共品供给方面存在哪些潜力与制约因素？如何通过财政工具、治理改革和区域合作提升公共品供给效率与可持续性？

AI.method: 混合方法的文献综合与政策分析

title: Value of Silence: Determinants and Consequences of Greenhushing
affiliations: , University of Texas at San Antonio, , University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS) and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: Value of Silence: Determinants and Consequences of Greenhushing
detail.abstract: Firms increasingly face pressure to communicate environmental initiatives, yet public claims can also invite scrutiny, political backlash, and credibility risk. We study greenhushing, defined as the strategic downplay of substantive environmental efforts, and develop a measure to capture the extent of a firm's greenhushing and greenwashing as the gap between firms' external environmental conduct and managerial communication in earnings calls. Using 30,786,703 sentences from quarterly earnings call transcripts, a high-salience and manager-led disclosure channel, for 3,727 U.S. firms (2005-2021), we measure environmental communication with the ESG-BERT deep learning model across six environmental dimensions and pair it with TruValue Labs' environmental Pulse Scores, which capture the valence of publicly available information about firms' environmental policies, actions, and outcomes. We show that greenhushing is higher in the post-2017 period associated with increased politicization, and varies systematically with firm and industry conditions. Specifically, the extent of greenhushing is greater for firms with more financial leverage and firms operating in competitive industries. We then examine the relationship between greenhushing and quarterly cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) post-earnings call. A one SD increase in Greenhushing Tendency (SD = 1.27) is associated with a 2.29 percentage point increase in three-month CAR (0.018 x 1.27 = 0.023), translating to about $238 million in market value for the average sample firm (mean market cap = $10.4 billion). The findings suggest that silence may carry informational value in environmental settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业"绿色沉默"（greenhushing）现象，即企业策略性地低调宣传自身实质性环保努力。通过分析2005-2021年3,727家美国企业的3,070万句财报电话会议记录，结合ESG-BERT深度学习模型和TruValue Labs环境脉冲评分，构建了衡量绿色沉默和绿色洗白的指标。研究发现，2017年后政治化加剧，绿色沉默现象更普遍；高财务杠杆和竞争激烈行业的企业更倾向于绿色沉默；绿色沉默与三个月累计异常回报（CAR）正相关，一个标准差增加对应约2.38亿美元市值增长。
AI.research_question: 企业是否以及如何在财报电话会议中有策略地低调宣传其环保努力（绿色沉默）？这种沉默是否具有信息价值？
AI.motivation: 企业面临日益增长的环保沟通压力，但公开环保声明也可能招致审查、政治反弹和信誉风险。现有研究多关注绿色洗白（夸大环保表现），而对绿色沉默（低调处理实质性环保努力）关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、企业战略沟通理论、政治化与社会压力理论
AI.method: 使用ESG-BERT深度学习模型分析30,786,703句财报电话会议记录，结合TruValue Labs环境脉冲评分，计算企业外部环保行为与管理层沟通之间的差距，构建绿色沉默和绿色洗白衡量指标。
AI.findings: 1) 2017年后绿色沉默显著增加，与环保议题政治化相关；2) 高财务杠杆企业和竞争激烈行业的企业更倾向于绿色沉默；3) 绿色沉默与三个月CAR正相关，一个标准差增加（1.27）对应2.29个百分点的CAR增长，约2.38亿美元市值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化绿色沉默现象，揭示了沉默在环保信息传递中可能具有积极信号价值，拓展了企业环保战略沟通的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、分析师和监管者提供理解企业环保沟通策略的新视角，提示绿色沉默可能并非负面信号，而是企业在政治化环境下的理性战略选择。

title: R-Function Regularization of Discontinuous Financial Payoffs
affiliations: Imperial College London - Faculty of Engineering and Investec Bank

detail.title: R-Function Regularization of Discontinuous Financial Payoffs
detail.abstract: Non-smooth payoff structures are a major source of numerical instability in option pricing and risk sensitivity estimation. Discontinuities and kinks degrade the performance of finite-difference, spectral, and Monte Carlo methods, and lead to unstable or ill-defined Greeks, particularly for digital and barrier-type derivatives. Classical regularization techniques alleviate some of these difficulties but are often problem-specific and do not preserve the logical structure of the payoff. In this paper, we introduce an R-function-based framework for constructing smooth approximations of discontinuous financial payoffs. Originally developed in geometric modelling, R-functions provide a systematic way to encode logical conditions such as conjunctions and disjunctions into continuous analytical representations while preserving domain structure. Combined with smooth sigmoid mappings, the proposed methodology yields globally differentiable payoff approximations suitable for pathwise and adjoint sensitivity analysis. A key observation of this work is that payoff smoothing reduces the effective dimension in the superposition sense by attenuating higher-order interactions, while principal component analysis (PCA) reduces the truncation dimension. These mechanisms are complementary and jointly improve the efficiency of randomized quasi-Monte Carlo (RQMC) methods. The methodology is illustrated for digital, corridor, and discrete barrier options under a hyperbolic local volatility model. Numerical experiments using Owen-scrambled Sobol' sequences combined with PCA-based path construction demonstrate substantial improvements in the stability and convergence of RQMC estimators. While standard smoothing approaches and R-function smoothing provide comparable pricing accuracy, the enhanced regularity of the proposed framework yields significantly improved sensitivity estimation, particularly for second-order Greeks. The results demonstrate that payoff smoothness plays a central role in reducing effective dimension and improving QMC efficiency. The proposed R-function framework provides a unified and flexible approach to payoff regularization for complex financial derivatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于R-函数的框架，对非光滑金融期权收益函数进行平滑近似处理，结合sigmoid映射和PCA降维，有效改善随机拟蒙特卡洛方法的稳定性和收敛性，尤其在希腊字母估计方面表现优异。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地构建非光滑金融收益函数的平滑近似，以解决期权定价和风险敏感性估计中的数值不稳定问题？
AI.motivation: 非平滑收益结构（如数字期权、障碍期权）中的不连续性和扭结会导致有限差分、谱方法和蒙特卡洛方法的数值不稳定，以及希腊字母估计不稳定或定义不清。现有正则化技术往往是问题特定的，且不能保持收益函数的逻辑结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: R-函数理论（用于编码逻辑条件的连续解析表示）、sigmoid平滑映射、有效维度和截断维度概念、主成分分析（PCA）、随机拟蒙特卡洛（RQMC）方法。
AI.method: 提出基于R-函数的收益平滑框架，结合sigmoid映射实现全局可微的收益近似；采用PCA路径构造；使用Owen-scrambled Sobol'序列进行RQMC模拟；在双曲局部波动率模型下对数字期权、走廊期权和离散障碍期权进行数值实验。
AI.findings: 收益平滑通过减弱高阶交互作用降低叠加意义上的有效维度，与PCA降低截断维度互补，共同提升RQMC效率。R-函数平滑与标准平滑方法在定价精度上相当，但在敏感性估计（尤其是二阶希腊字母）上显著更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了收益平滑度在降低有效维度和提升QMC效率中的核心作用；建立了R-函数框架与金融收益平滑之间的理论联系；将几何建模领域的R-函数方法系统引入金融衍生品定价。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种统一且灵活的收益正则化框架，适用于复杂金融衍生品；有效改善了希腊字母估计的稳定性和精度；为高频交易和风险管理中的敏感性分析提供了更可靠的数值工具。

title: Peer Pay Inequality and Innovation: Evidence from Salary History Bans
affiliations: Rutgers Business School, University of Connecticut and University of Connecticut - Department of Finance

detail.title: Peer Pay Inequality and Innovation: Evidence from Salary History Bans
detail.abstract: We distinguish horizontal, or peer-level, pay dispersion from vertical pay dispersion and examine its impact on innovation. Using the staggered adoption of state-level salary history bans, we show that the laws significantly reduce horizontal pay dispersion while leaving vertical pay dispersion largely unchanged. Treated firms experience an 11-16% increase in patent value, with stronger effects where peer-pay inequality is more pronounced and innovation depends more heavily on employee effort and collaboration. Consistently, treated firms experience lower employee turnover and greater team-level collaboration and productivity. Our findings suggest that mitigating pay inequality among peers improves innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了薪酬不平等对企业创新的影响。通过利用美国各州薪酬历史禁令的颁布，区分了水平（同层级）薪酬分散和垂直（层级间）薪酬分散。研究发现，这些法律显著降低了水平薪酬分散，而对垂直薪酬分散影响不大。受法律影响的企业专利价值增加了11-16%，在同行薪酬不平等更严重、创新更依赖员工努力和协作的企业中效果更强。机制检验显示，这些企业员工离职率降低，团队协作和生产力提升。
AI.research_question: 水平薪酬分散（同事间的薪酬不平等）如何影响企业创新？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对薪酬不平等与创新关系的研究存在争议，且多聚焦于垂直薪酬分散（高管与员工间的差距）。本文旨在区分水平与垂直两种薪酬分散形式，利用薪酬历史禁令这一外生冲击，探究降低同事间薪酬不平等对创新的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公平理论、社会比较理论和协作激励理论。水平薪酬不平等可能通过降低员工公平感、削弱协作意愿和增加离职倾向来抑制创新。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法，利用美国各州薪酬历史禁令的逐步推行作为外生冲击。数据来源包括专利数据、企业财务数据和员工调查数据。
AI.findings: 1）薪酬历史禁令显著降低了水平薪酬分散，对垂直薪酬分散无显著影响。2）受法律影响的企业专利价值提升11-16%。3）效应在同行薪酬不平等更严重、创新更依赖员工努力和协作的企业中更强。4）机制为降低员工离职率、提升团队协作和生产力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次清晰区分水平和垂直薪酬分散对创新的不同影响。2）为薪酬不平等抑制创新的观点提供了因果证据。3）揭示了公平感知和协作在创新过程中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为薪酬历史禁令等政策提供了积极的经济后果证据。2）建议企业关注同事间的薪酬公平性以促进创新。3）为薪酬结构设计提供了实证指导。

title: Imploding Posteriors
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Imploding Posteriors
detail.abstract: We develop a probabilistic bridge between the Bayesian computation programme of Polson and Sokolov (2026) for the Navier-Stokes equations and Marc Yor's probabilistic calculus (Bessel processes, exponential functionals of Brownian motion, and the generalised inverse Gaussian family), and we tie both to the Merle-Raphaël-Rodnianski-Szeftel (MRRS) construction of finite-time imploding singularities for the three-dimensional compressible Euler and Navier-Stokes equations. The central thesis is that the quantised self-similar speeds appearing in MRRS have a Bayesian shadow: they index a discrete spectrum of distinguishable hypotheses in a sequential model-comparison problem, and the associated spectral gaps control the Fisher-information separation rate of a well-specified particle filter. The same generalised inverse Gaussian augmentations that make Yor-type exponential functionals tractable supply heavy-tailed likelihoods under which Bayesian computation remains stable in regimes approaching MRRS-type blow-up. We propose a diagnostic, the imploding posterior, that, conditional on a trajectory lying in some MRRS basin, identifies which profile is being tracked through an information-theoretic phase transition in sequential Bayesian updating, and we outline a research programme connecting the modulation analysis of Merle-Raphaël to the generative Bayesian computation of Polson and Sokolov.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了贝叶斯计算（Polson & Sokolov, 2026）与Yor概率演算（Bessel过程、布朗运动指数泛函、广义逆高斯族）之间的概率桥梁，并将其与三维可压缩Euler/Navier-Stokes方程的MRRS有限时间自相似奇点构造相联系。核心论点是：MRRS中量化的自相似速度具有贝叶斯“影子”——它们标识了序列模型比较问题中可区分离散假设的光谱，而光谱间隙控制着良设粒子滤波器的Fisher信息分离率。Yor型指数泛函所需的广义逆高斯增广提供了重尾似然，使贝叶斯计算在接近MRRS爆破解的区域仍保持稳定。我们提出了“内爆后验”诊断指标，并概述了连接Merle-Raphaël调制分析与Polson-Sokolov生成式贝叶斯计算的研究纲领。
AI.research_question: 如何建立MRRS奇点构造（可压缩Euler/Navier-Stokes方程有限时间自相似内爆）与贝叶斯概率计算（Polson & Sokolov, 2026）及Yor型随机过程（Bessel过程、指数泛函、GIG分布）之间的深层数学联系？
AI.motivation: MRRS奇点构造中出现的量化自相似速度与贝叶斯模型比较中的离散假设谱之间存在惊人的结构对应，但这种对应缺乏系统的概率论基础。同时，贝叶斯计算在处理接近奇点的极端流体动力学场景时面临数值稳定性挑战，而Yor型指数泛函提供的重尾似然框架可能提供解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 贝叶斯计算框架（Polson & Sokolov, 2026）；2) Marc Yor的概率演算（Bessel过程、布朗运动指数泛函）；3) 广义逆高斯（GIG）分布族；4) MRRS奇点构造理论（Merle-Raphaël-Rodnianski-Szeftel）；5) Fisher信息与粒子滤波器；6) 调制分析与信息论模型比较
AI.method: 理论建构：建立贝叶斯推断与MRRS奇点之间的概率映射；通过广义逆高斯增广实现Yor型指数泛函的可计算性；提出“内爆后验”（imploding posterior）作为诊断指标；设计序列模型比较框架，利用Fisher信息分离率刻画奇点追踪精度。
AI.findings: 1) MRRS量化自相似速度与贝叶斯模型比较中的离散假设谱之间存在一一对应；2) 光谱间隙控制着良设粒子滤波器的Fisher信息分离率；3) 广义逆高斯增广使Yor型指数泛函在计算上可处理，并生成重尾似然，在接近MRRS爆破解时保持贝叶斯计算的数值稳定性；4) “内爆后验”可通过信息论相变识别轨迹所在的MRRS basin并追踪特定奇点剖面。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次建立了MRRS奇点理论与贝叶斯概率计算之间的系统性桥梁；2) 将Yor型随机过程（Bessel过程、指数泛函）与流体动力学奇点问题深度结合；3) 揭示了量化自相似速度的贝叶斯“影子”及其信息论含义；4) 提出了连接调制分析与生成式贝叶斯计算的统一研究纲领。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了在接近奇点区域仍保持稳定的贝叶斯计算方法（重尾似然框架）；2) 提出了“内爆后验”这一可用于识别和追踪特定MRRS奇点剖面的计算诊断工具；3) 为流体动力学中奇点检测和追踪提供了信息论与贝叶斯计算的新途径。

title: TopoDTI: A Topological Role-Aware Hybrid Framework for Drug-Target Interaction Prediction
affiliations: China Pharmaceutical University, Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications and Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications

detail.title: TopoDTI: A Topological Role-Aware Hybrid Framework for Drug-Target Interaction Prediction
detail.abstract: Drug-Target Interaction (DTI) prediction is a foundational task in computational drug discovery. While emerging deep learning-based approaches typically employ dual-tower architectures to distill intrinsic biochemical attributes, they overlook the fact that the identity of a drug or target is defined not only by its molecular structure but also by its global topological role within the pharmacological interaction space. Existing methods to incorporate relational context either remain restricted to local pairwise dependencies or rely on similarity-based graph construction, which is frequently noisy and biologically unreliable. To address these limitations, we propose TopoDTI, a topological role-aware hybrid framework that synergistically integrates global topological dependencies with intrinsic biochemical attributes without relying on auxiliary knowledge bases. Specifically, TopoDTI comprises two core components: a Global Role Encoder (GRE) and a Harmonized Hybrid Optimization (HHO) strategy. The GRE manifests latent topological roles by modeling high-order relational patterns within the DTI bipartite graph. Through a semi-supervised contrastive learning paradigm, it captures informative structural knowledge beyond immediate connectivity, yielding expressive topology-aware representations. To mediate the optimization imbalance inherent in learning from these disparate feature spaces, we introduce the HHO strategy. By decoupling early-stage optimization and progressively coordinating the distinct learning dynamics of topological and biochemical views, HHO ensures stable convergence and prevents representation collapse. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that TopoDTI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art in Accuracy and AUPR. Further analyses confirm that modeling global interaction topology substantially enhances model generalization and robustness, particularly in data-sparse scenarios.

AI.tldr: TopoDTI提出了一种拓扑角色感知的混合框架，通过全局角色编码器（GRE）和协调混合优化（HHO）策略，协同整合全局拓扑依赖与内在生化属性，在药物-靶标相互作用预测中显著优于现有方法，尤其在数据稀疏场景下表现突出。
AI.research_question: 如何将全局拓扑角色信息与内在生化属性有效整合，以提升药物-靶标相互作用（DTI）预测的性能？
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法主要采用双塔架构提取内在生化属性，忽略了药物或靶标的身份不仅由其分子结构定义，还由其在整个药理交互空间中的全局拓扑角色定义。同时，现有融入关系上下文的方法要么局限于局部成对依赖，要么依赖基于相似性的图构建，往往存在噪声且生物可靠性不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拓扑角色感知理论、图神经网络、对比学习、多视图优化协调理论
AI.method: 提出TopoDTI框架，包含两个核心组件：（1）全局角色编码器（GRE），通过对DTI二分图中的高阶关系模式建模，通过半监督对比学习范式捕获超越直接连接的拓扑结构知识；（2）协调混合优化（HHO）策略，通过解耦早期优化并逐步协调拓扑与生化视图的不同学习动态，确保稳定收敛并防止表征崩塌。
AI.findings: 在基准数据集上，TopoDTI在准确率和AUPR指标上持续优于当前最先进方法。进一步分析表明，建模全局交互拓扑显著增强了模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性，尤其是在数据稀疏场景下。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将全局拓扑角色与内在生化属性协同整合的新范式，弥合了局部依赖方法与全局拓扑建模之间的理论鸿沟；引入了半监督对比学习用于DTI图的高阶关系建模；提出了协调混合优化策略解决多视图特征空间的学习不平衡问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为药物发现领域提供了一种更准确、更鲁棒的DTI预测工具，无需依赖外部知识库；在数据稀疏场景下表现优异，降低了计算药物发现对大量标注数据的依赖，具有实际应用价值。
